G0223J.name: Alexander
G0223J.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0223J.brief: Opponent of Paul, along with Hymenaeus
G0223J.short: Alexander, along with Hymenaeus, was an opponent of Paul's teaching and was handed over to Satan by Paul.

G0223I.name: Alexander
G0223I.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0223I.brief: Jew put forward by the crowd in Ephesus
G0223I.short: Alexander was a Jew whom the crowd put forward during the riot in Ephesus, but they shouted him down when they realized he was a Jew.

G0223H.name: Alexander
G0223H.desc: Priest living at the time of the New Testament
G0223H.brief: Member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem
G0223H.short: Alexander was a member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem who was present during Peter and John's interrogation before the Sanhedrin.

G0223G.name: Alexander
G0223G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0223G.brief: Son of Simon who carried the cross
G0223G.short: Alexander was the son of Simon of Cyrene, who was compelled to carry Jesus' cross.

G0256.name: Alphaeus
G0256.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0256.brief: Father of apostles James and Matthew (Levi)
G0256.short: Alphaeus was the father of two of Jesus' apostles, James and Matthew (also known as Levi).

G0291.name: Ampliatus
G0291.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0291.brief: Believer greeted by Paul in Rome
G0291.short: Ampliatus, a beloved fellow believer greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

G0207.name: Aquila
G0207.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0207.brief: Jewish Christian tentmaker, co-worker with Paul
G0207.short: Aquila, along with his wife Priscilla, was a Jewish Christian who worked as a tentmaker and played a significant role in the early church, partnering with Paul in his ministry.

G0222.name: Alexandria
G0222.short: Alexandria, a significant port city in Egypt, played a role in Paul's journey to Rome.

G0295.name: Amphipolis
G0295.brief: A city visited by Paul on his missionary journey.
G0295.short: Amphipolis, a city in Macedonia, passed through by Paul and Silas.
